# Tidepool Landing Page: Build Plan

**Visual direction:** Deep teal and sand, with a single warm accent (tangerine). The Library reference uses forest green and coral, so this keeps the same kind of structure with a different identity. Type pairing: a humanist sans for headlines and body (e.g., Inter or Source Sans), and a mono for data labels and the pull quote.

**1. Nav (sticky, 64px)**
Logo left, three links (Product, Pricing, Stories), "Log in" text link, and a filled "Start free" button. Background: sand, with a hairline border that appears on scroll.

**2. Hero**
Two columns, 55/45. Left: headline "Plan your week together. Finally." (max 8 words), a one-sentence subhead naming small teams, and a primary CTA with a secondary "See how it works" link. Right: a tilted product screenshot of a shared week board with three avatars visibly editing. Background: a soft teal gradient with a single hand-drawn wave line that flows from the headline into the screenshot.

**3. Week strip**
Full-width horizontal timeline, Mon to Sun, with a circular node per day. Each node shows a count of open tasks and the avatar of the owner. Caption in mono: "Your team's week, at a glance."

**4. Problem**
Three short cards on sand: "Scattered tasks," "Surprise conflicts," "Status meetings." Each has a one-line sentence and a small line icon. No stock photos.

**5. How it works**
Three numbered steps in a row: Create the week, Assign owners, Check in daily. Each step gets a 16:9 screenshot below. Copy is imperative and under 15 words per step.

**6. Feature rows**
Two or three alternating rows (text left, screenshot right, then reversed). Topics: shared calendar, handoffs, recurring routines. Each has a bold claim headline and two bullets.

**7. Pull quote**
Full-width band in deep teal. Quote in mono at 28px, attributed with name, role, and team size ("Ops lead, 6-person agency").

**8. Proof strip**
Four stats in mono on a sand band (e.g., "Average planning time: 12 min/week"). Include only verified figures.

**9. Pricing**
Three tiers, with the middle one highlighted. Priced by team size, not seats. Toggle for monthly/annual.

**10. FAQ**
Five accordion items covering team size limits, data export, integrations, and cancellation.

**11. Closing CTA**
Full-bleed teal band, centered headline "Start your first week in five minutes," one button, and a line noting free for teams up to five.

**12. Footer**
Four columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal), with a small wave mark and copyright.

# Tidepool Landing Page: Revised Build Plan

**Visual direction:** Deep teal and sand, with tangerine used only as a fill behind dark text, never as text on sand (contrast fails). Type: a humanist sans (Inter or Source Sans) for headlines and body. Mono is reserved for small data labels and timestamps. Pull quotes use the sans at a larger size, since long mono text is hard to read. Imagery is always real product UI, never stock photos.

**1. Nav (sticky, 64px)**
Logo, three links (Product, Pricing, Customers), "Log in," and a "Start free" button. Background is sand, with a hairline border that appears on scroll.

**2. Hero**
Two columns, 55/45. Headline: "One shared plan for your team's week." Subhead: "Tidepool gives small teams one list, one calendar, and clear owners, so Monday's plan still holds on Friday." Primary CTA "Start free," with a secondary "Watch a 2-minute tour." Right side: a product screenshot of a week board with three avatars visibly editing, slightly angled with a soft shadow. No decorative line art; the hero should earn attention through the product.

**3. Trust bar**
One row of customer names or logos, with a placeholder note until approved logos are available. No stats here.

**4. Problem**
Three cards on sand: "Tasks live in five places," "Owners are unclear," "Weekly syncs eat the afternoon." Each card has one sentence and one simple line icon.

**5. How it works**
Three numbered steps in a row: "Set the week," "Assign owners," "Check in once a day." Each step has a 16:9 screenshot and under 15 words of copy in the imperative.

**6. Feature rows**
Three alternating rows (text and screenshot, then reversed): shared week board, handoffs between owners, recurring routines. Each has a bold claim headline and two bullets that name a concrete action.

**7. Pull quote**
Full-width deep-teal band. Quote in sans at 32px, with name, role, and team size. Use a real, approved quote only.

**8. Proof**
Two to three figures drawn from customer data, each with a source note. If no data exists yet, omit the section rather than invent numbers.

**9. Pricing**
Three tiers by team size, with the middle tier highlighted in tangerine fill. Monthly/annual toggle. Each tier lists the one limit that matters for its team size.

**10. FAQ**
Five accordion items: team size limits, data export, integrations, how billing changes, and cancellation.

**11. Closing CTA**
Full-bleed teal band. Headline: "Plan next week before this one ends." One button. Free-tier terms go in a line below, confirmed by the pricing team before launch.

**12. Footer**
Four columns (Product, Company, Resources, Legal). Wave mark, copyright, and a status-page link.

**Build notes:** Every section must work at 375px, with the week board stacking above its copy. All text meets WCAG AA contrast. Each CTA uses the same "Start free" label.
